controls.source: /** Internal route rendered as a react-router <Link>. */
* With href, render a plain <a> (full page navigation) instead of a
* react-router <Link>. Used for plugin routes mounted at /api/v2/plugin-content/plugins/...
/** Without href, the item renders as a <button>. */

// A same-URL click needs no guard here: React Router turns a `<Link>`

internal static (ContentDialog Dialog, List<CheckBox> Checks) Build(XamlRoot root, RequestMediaDetail item)

var dialog = new ContentDialog { Title = $"Request seasons · {item.Title}", XamlRoot = root, Content = new ScrollViewer { Content = choices, MaxHeight = 430 }, PrimaryButtonText = "Request selected", CloseButtonText = "Cancel" };
var missing = new Button { Content = "Missing aired" }; missing.Click += (_, _) => Select(s => RequestViewerPolicy.HasAired(s, today)); quick.Children.Add(missing);

var latestButton = new Button { Content = "Latest", IsEnabled = latest != null && RequestViewerPolicy.SeasonRequestable(latest) }; latestButton.Click += (_, _) => Select(s => s == latest); quick.Children.Add(latestButton);

var upcoming = new Button { Content = "Upcoming", IsEnabled = seasons.Any(s => RequestViewerPolicy.SeasonRequestable(s) && !RequestViewerPolicy.HasAired(s, today)) }; upcoming.Click += (_, _) => Select(s => !RequestViewerPolicy.HasAired(s, today)); quick.Children.Add(upcoming);

var check = new CheckBox { Tag = season.SeasonNumber, Content = $"{season.Name ?? $"Season {season.SeasonNumber}"} · {note}", IsEnabled = RequestViewerPolicy.SeasonRequestable(season), IsChecked = defaults.Contains(season.SeasonNumber) };
